messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content: 邁克贏了。邁克的手牌 9♠ 10♠ J♠ Q♠ K♠ 是一手順子同花（straight‑flush），而約翰的 8♥ 10♥ J♥ Q♥ K♥ 只是一手同花（flush），沒有形成順子。順子同花比同花高，故邁克勝出。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K hearts: that's a straight flush (8-10-J-Q-K). Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠. That's also a straight flush? 9-10-J-Q-K spades: that's a straight flush. Which is higher? In poker, straight flush ranking: highest card matters. John's highest card is K♥, Mike's highest card is K♠. Both have same high card K. Next compare next highest: J vs J? Actually both have same sequence: 9-10-J-Q-K vs 8-10-J-Q-K. Wait John's sequence: 8,10,J,Q,K. That's not a consecutive sequence because missing 9. Actually 8-10-J-Q-K is not a straight because missing 9. Straight requires consecutive ranks. So John's hand is not a straight flush. It's a flush (hearts) with high card K, but not a straight. Mike's hand: 9♠,10♠,J♠,Q♠,K♠ is a straight flush (9-10-J-Q-K). So Mike wins. So answer: Mike wins.
